text: A written plan covering functional and technical design, staffing, timeframe, budget, and market plan will be delivered by two weeks.
The group decided that the project will focus on designing a remote control for television and will start with that remote control as the first product.
The project manager will send a copy of the slides to all attendees at the conclusion of the meeting.
ID(FIE073) will identify additional contributors from marketing, technical, and administration for the plan and inform PM.
UI will determine the functional design as the immediate next step.
